about_short_description.short_description: Vitalize Care is solving the most pressing clinical operations problems for health systems, starting with optimizing staffing and scheduling

product.name: Vitalize Care Platform
product.description: A platform that optimizes staffing and scheduling in health systems by matching nurse staffing to real-time patient demand and acuity.

product.name: Central Staffing Module
product.description: A module that uses data-driven analysis to optimize hospital-wide staffing decisions and reduce bonus and overtime labor costs.

product.name: Unit-Level Scheduling Module
product.description: A scheduling tool that automates nurse schedule creation and open shift management at the unit level to reduce manual workload for nurse managers.

product.name: Analytics and Reporting Module
product.description: A tool that provides real-time data and customizable reports on staffing, productivity, budget, and labor costs for nurse leaders and hospital executives.

product.name: Mobile-First Scheduling for Staff
product.description: A mobile scheduling solution that enables nurses to self-schedule, swap shifts, and manage PTO with transparency and flexibility.
